# Lyriix Android 0.2.16

- Privacy mode works locally the moment you turn it on, even before pairing a PC.
- Pick the same private Discord activity shown on Windows: hide it, show “Using privacy mode on Lyriix,” or show “Listening to Lyriix.”
- Choose visible times, a private `--:--` label with the progress bar, or no progress. Visible privacy activity keeps the Lyriix Download button.
